reviewer: Independent AI evaluation agent; no human study
rubric_interpretation: Pass requires a relevant conversational response fulfilling the main request. A generic acknowledgement alone does not satisfy a request with explicit content preferences. Surface plausibility and exact sentence novelty are separate from correctness. Semantic relevance and syntactic quality are recorded separately; minor noun-capitalization errors alone are not classified as a broken sentence.
